user_task_status_projection.default_user_question: Within the selected scope, which projects are moving, which are paused, which need a user decision, which need system handling, and what is each task's current stage, liveness, and token usage?
mental_model_layers: agent/capability: which agent, capability package, or module is responsible
project: which project line, study, or deliverable track this work belongs to
task/work item: the user-visible unit that is advancing, waiting, or blocked
execution run: the current stage run, heartbeat, usage, and blocker route for this task

count_policies.running_task_count: count user tasks projected as actively running or advancing, never raw provider attempts
count_policies.active_project_count: count active user-visible project lines from the framework project-line projection
count_policies.queued_project_count: count queued or waiting user-visible project/task lines without claiming active worker runs
count_policies.attention_count: count user-visible blockers, human gates, failed safe actions, or owner attention states
count_policies.in_progress_count: count tasks whose user-facing primary_state is in_progress
count_policies.delivered_auto_paused_count: count tasks whose user-facing primary_state is delivered_auto_paused
count_policies.paused_count: count tasks whose user-facing primary_state is paused_waiting_for_direction
count_policies.owner_decision_count: count tasks whose user-facing primary_state is owner_decision_required
count_policies.system_attention_count: count tasks whose user-facing primary_state is system_attention_required
count_policies.automation_running_count: count tasks whose automation_state is automation_running

user_task_status_projection.running_state_policy: only explicit running, in_progress, or advancing status/state counts as running; active_run_id alone is context, not liveness proof; queued, pending, and waiting require explicit projected status; blocked or attention_needed stay blocked/attention states; stopped, parked, and checkpointed stay inactive and must not be relabeled queued
user_task_status_projection.queue_status_policy: queued, pending, and waiting require explicit projected status; blocked or attention_needed stay blocked/attention states; stopped, parked, and checkpointed stay inactive; non-running must never be inferred as queued
user_task_status_projection.progress_label_policy: render framework progress classification and stage labels as human task progress labels without exposing raw projection or ledger names
user_task_status_projection.telemetry_missing_policy: when stage elapsed, heartbeat, or usage telemetry is absent, the Runtime page must surface telemetry missing instead of leaving the area blank or inferring a healthy run

agent_module_status_panel.source: task capability/module refs separated from task liveness
agent_module_status_panel.display_policy: render agent, capability, connector, and module status in a dedicated panel instead of mixing them into stage/run telemetry

user_task_status_projection.mas_runtime_acceptance_display_policy: show MAS owner consumption fields as user-facing acceptance/currentness status, e.g. 'MAS accepted this runtime result' and 'accepted result matches latest runtime closeout'; keep raw refs and stage attempt ids secondary as evidence, not the primary wording
user_task_status_projection.diagnostic_source_policy: provider/projection/ref/ledger/current_control_state details stay secondary and are not the default page language

default_attention.queue_status_policy: queued, pending, and waiting require explicit projected status; blocked or attention_needed stay blocked/attention states; stopped, parked, and checkpointed stay inactive; non-running must never be inferred as queued
secondary_fields: last heartbeat / running proof or telemetry missing
current stage usage / task total usage or telemetry missing
typed blocker summary / owner / resolution route

running_task_projection.active_execution_filter: states where running_provider_attempt is true and provider_run.provider_status or current_attempt_state is running
